label: M6_DCM-Auth
info: Keycloak/OIDC authentication. All credentials and configuration are defined directly inside the Auth credentials & configuration manager function node. No flow/global context is used. MongoDB stores only short-lived application sessions and audit records.

name: ══ Node-local Keycloak Authentication Backend ══
info:
All Keycloak/OIDC credentials, endpoints, client IDs, session settings, role/access mappings, and MongoDB collection names are defined directly in the Auth credentials & configuration manager node.

The manager attaches the configuration to the current message as msg._authConfig. It is removed before the response leaves the authentication flow.

No flow context, global context, tab environment variables, or On Start configuration is used.

func: msg.payload = { response: { action: "logOut", status: "success" } }; delete msg.collection; delete msg.operation; return msg;
